privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how SIA HA Group processes personal data submitted through the contact form on iepako.hagroup.lv.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: SIA HA Group, registration number 40203724866, VAT number LV40203724866. For questions about personal data, contact info@hagroup.lv.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.content: The contact form processes your full name, company (if provided), email, phone (if provided), selected product, expected volume, enquiry text, privacy acknowledgement, interface language, page URL and submission time. A separate record contains only your acknowledgement of the necessary-storage notice.

sections.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis
sections.content: We use the data to assess your enquiry, prepare an offer and communicate about a potential transaction. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract and our legitimate interest in managing business communications. The privacy acknowledgement confirms that you have read this information; it does not replace the applicable legal basis.

sections.title: 4. Storage and recipients
sections.content: Submissions are stored in Google Firebase / Cloud Firestore in the separate iepako_contacts collection and are accessible only to authorised HA Group personnel. The website is hosted on Amazon Web Services S3 and CloudFront. We retain data for as long as needed to handle the enquiry, manage cooperation and defend reasonable legal claims, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: 5. Data transfers
sections.content: Service providers may process data on our behalf under contractual and security requirements. Where data is processed outside the European Economic Area, we use applicable safeguards. We do not sell personal data or share it with advertisers.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.content: You may request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your data and object to processing where applicable law provides these rights. You may lodge a complaint with the Latvian Data State Inspectorate. Send requests to info@hagroup.lv.

cookies.title: Cookie and browser storage policy
cookies.intro: iepako.hagroup.lv does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: 1. What we use
sections.content: The website uses first-party local storage to remember your language, your acknowledgement of this notice and a short-lived form-submission protection value. These values provide functionality you request.

sections.title: 2. Firestore notice record
sections.content: When you select “Understood”, we store the notice version, necessary-only choice, interface language, server creation time and expiry in the separate iepako_consents Firestore collection. The record does not include your name, email, page URL or a persistent visitor identifier.

sections.title: 3. Retention
sections.content: The language preference remains in the browser until you change it or clear browser data. The notice acknowledgement is intended to remain in the browser and Firestore for up to 12 months. The form-protection timestamp is short-lived.

sections.title: 4. Managing your choice
sections.content: You can remove local storage through your browser settings. The “Cookie settings” link in the footer reopens this notice. If necessary storage is blocked, your language preference and some form behaviour may not be retained.

sections.title: 5. Changes
sections.content: If we introduce analytics, advertising or other optional technologies, we will update this policy and request an appropriate choice before activating them. Send questions to info@hagroup.lv.
